summary: 61-year-old woman two weeks after colonoscopy with complete removal of three adenomas, one 14 mm (advanced). BSG/ACPGBI/PHE 2020: one-off surveillance colonoscopy at 3 years.

inputs.hpi: Screening colonoscopy two weeks ago (FIT-positive in a private screening check). Complete to caecum, good preparation. Three tubular adenomas removed: 14 mm sigmoid (low-grade dysplasia), 6 mm and 4 mm descending. All retrieved; complete excision. Asymptomatic.

imaging.name: Colonoscopy
imaging.result: Complete to caecum, Boston bowel preparation score 8. Three tubular adenomas removed en bloc: 14 mm sigmoid (LGD), 6 mm and 4 mm descending (LGD). No residual polyp.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Colorectal adenomas — high-risk findings after polypectomy
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Three adenomas, one ≥ 10 mm (advanced). BSG 2020 high-risk findings: surveillance colonoscopy at 3 years.

mustInclude.note: BSG 2020: ≥ 2 premalignant polyps with ≥ 1 advanced (adenoma ≥ 10 mm or HGD), or ≥ 5 premalignant polyps → one-off colonoscopy at 3 years. Low-risk findings → no colonoscopic surveillance (return to screening).

guideline.name: BSG/ACPGBI/PHE post-polypectomy and post-colorectal cancer resection surveillance guidelines
guideline.section: High-risk findings → one-off surveillance colonoscopy at 3 years; low-risk findings → no surveillance, return to screening
guideline.citation: Rutter MD, East J, Rees CJ, et al. British Society of Gastroenterology/Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland/Public Health England post-polypectomy and post-colorectal cancer resection surveillance guidelines. Gut. 2020;69:201–223.

rationale: Surveillance interval check. No engine has a polyp-surveillance rule; the expectation is quality and documents the gap.

authoring.author: Claude (colorectal/anorectal cluster)
authoring.notes: Expectations need surgeon sign-off (reviewedBy). Citations verified: false until checked against the source.
